CREATE TABLE hook_conversions (

    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    violations_json TEXT NOT NULL
, run_id TEXT, run_status TEXT, failed_step_id TEXT, total_duration_ms REAL, structure_signature TEXT)

schema:
CREATE TABLE hook_conversions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_run ON receipts(run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_cache_key ON refinement_log(cache_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_session ON refinement_log(session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    violations_json TEXT NOT NULL
, run_id TEXT, run_status TEXT, failed_step_id TEXT, total_duration_ms REAL, structure_signature TEXT)

schema:
CREATE TABLE hook_conversions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_run ON receipts(run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_cache_key ON refinement_log(cache_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_session ON refinement_log(session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    violations_json TEXT NOT NULL
, run_id TEXT, run_status TEXT, failed_step_id TEXT, total_duration_ms REAL, structure_signature TEXT)

schema:
CREATE TABLE hook_conversions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_run ON receipts(run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_cache_key ON refinement_log(cache_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_session ON refinement_log(session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    violations_json TEXT NOT NULL
, run_id TEXT, run_status TEXT, failed_step_id TEXT, total_duration_ms REAL, structure_signature TEXT)

schema:
CREATE TABLE hook_conversions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_run ON receipts(run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_cache_key ON refinement_log(cache_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_session ON refinement_log(session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    violations_json TEXT NOT NULL
, run_id TEXT, run_status TEXT, failed_step_id TEXT, total_duration_ms REAL, structure_signature TEXT)

schema:
CREATE TABLE hook_conversions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_run ON receipts(run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_cache_key ON refinement_log(cache_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_session ON refinement_log(session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    violations_json TEXT NOT NULL
, run_id TEXT, run_status TEXT, failed_step_id TEXT, total_duration_ms REAL, structure_signature TEXT)

schema:
CREATE TABLE envelope_cache (
    cache_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    prompt_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_prompt_version ON envelope_cache(prompt_version)

CREATE TABLE hook_conversions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_run ON receipts(run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_cache_key ON refinement_log(cache_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_session ON refinement_log(session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    violations_json TEXT NOT NULL
, run_id TEXT, run_status TEXT, failed_step_id TEXT, total_duration_ms REAL, structure_signature TEXT)

CREATE TABLE pathways (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    task_description TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_embedding_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_template_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_trace_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    hit_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    distilled_at REAL NOT NULL,
    embedding_model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    embedding_model_version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    last_activation_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
    failure_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    structure_signature TEXT,
    parameters_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
)

schema:
CREATE TABLE hook_conversions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_run ON receipts(run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_cache_key ON refinement_log(cache_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_session ON refinement_log(session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    violations_json TEXT NOT NULL
, run_id TEXT, run_status TEXT, failed_step_id TEXT, total_duration_ms REAL, structure_signature TEXT)

schema:
CREATE TABLE hook_conversions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_run ON receipts(run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_cache_key ON refinement_log(cache_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_session ON refinement_log(session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    violations_json TEXT NOT NULL
, run_id TEXT, run_status TEXT, failed_step_id TEXT, total_duration_ms REAL, structure_signature TEXT)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,

    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

schema:
CREATE TABLE hook_conversions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_run ON receipts(run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_cache_key ON refinement_log(cache_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_session ON refinement_log(session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    violations_json TEXT NOT NULL
, run_id TEXT, run_status TEXT, failed_step_id TEXT, total_duration_ms REAL, structure_signature TEXT)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,

schema:
CREATE TABLE hook_conversions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_run ON receipts(run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_cache_key ON refinement_log(cache_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_session ON refinement_log(session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,

schema:
CREATE TABLE hook_conversions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_run ON receipts(run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_cache_key ON refinement_log(cache_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_session ON refinement_log(session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    violations_json TEXT NOT NULL
, run_id TEXT, run_status TEXT, failed_step_id TEXT, total_duration_ms REAL, structure_signature TEXT)

schema:
CREATE TABLE hook_conversions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_run ON receipts(run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_cache_key ON refinement_log(cache_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_session ON refinement_log(session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    violations_json TEXT NOT NULL
, run_id TEXT, run_status TEXT, failed_step_id TEXT, total_duration_ms REAL, structure_signature TEXT)

schema:
CREATE TABLE hook_conversions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_run ON receipts(run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_cache_key ON refinement_log(cache_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_session ON refinement_log(session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    violations_json TEXT NOT NULL
, run_id TEXT, run_status TEXT, failed_step_id TEXT, total_duration_ms REAL, structure_signature TEXT)

CREATE TABLE hook_conversions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    violations_json TEXT NOT NULL
, run_id TEXT, run_status TEXT, failed_step_id TEXT, total_duration_ms REAL, structure_signature TEXT)

schema:
CREATE TABLE hook_conversions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_run ON receipts(run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_cache_key ON refinement_log(cache_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_session ON refinement_log(session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    violations_json TEXT NOT NULL
, run_id TEXT, run_status TEXT, failed_step_id TEXT, total_duration_ms REAL, structure_signature TEXT)

schema:
CREATE TABLE hook_conversions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_run ON receipts(run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_cache_key ON refinement_log(cache_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_session ON refinement_log(session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    violations_json TEXT NOT NULL
, run_id TEXT, run_status TEXT, failed_step_id TEXT, total_duration_ms REAL, structure_signature TEXT)
